invalidation_rule: PICKS: first target before a daily close >3% beyond the far zone edge opposite his direction. INDEX LEVELS: a support call resolves WIN if ES bounces from the level before closing >0.5% below it; a resistance/short-trigger call resolves WIN if ES rejects before closing >0.5% above (forward-only; recent calls stay OPEN until ES data accrues).
multiple_comparison_note: He posts many levels/picks; some resolve by chance. Hit-rate is raw (not multiplicity-adjusted). Treat a high rate at small n with caution.
honesty: FORWARD-ONLY (no backfill). His emailed picks are DISCRETIONARY and scored SEPARATELY from the methodology (which is already the engine). Methodology=primary does NOT validate every emailed pick — this score does. n>=30 before any verdict; picks do NOT vote.
